mappings.coverage: complete qualified original own-body memory projection
mappings.qualification: 656080 gates on stored deadline<=input time with unordered skip; positive signed16countdown decrements and returns. Creation caches input time, writes ring time, exactx8764 emitterXYZ+cueXYZ sums with binary32 spills, then three raw cue attributes. Signed16ring index reloads before each floating position and once before raw triple destination. Index increments and compares signed16 against fresh signedbyte physical rate, resets as original and optionally latches new index to countdown. Deadline uses original cached time plus exactx8764 finite lifetime/signedrate. Zero rate retains masked x87 signedInfinity for nonzero finite lifetime or indefiniteFFC00000 for signed-zero lifetime. No added zero-rate guard. Paired aliases include index8Xstore rewriting index/countdown word before later row stores and raw attributes replacing physical rate before wrapping/deadline computation. All255nonzero signed rate bytes, negative counters/indices, finite extremes, gate NaNs/Infinities and zero-rate creation are retained.
